authorization.interpretation: Approve PHASE_2_PLAN.md and start Phase 2 Step 1. No Step 2 runtime, model calls, candidate execution or hosted CI authorized.

vt_obligations.description: Calls, failed/retried attempts, intended positions and dependency groups remain correct in comparisons.
Intended-group endpoints cannot use later groups to fill missing early positions.
Incompatible/missing domains, horizons, schema/rubric meanings restrict affected comparisons.
Revisions recompute pair subsets, comparisons, means, intervals and decisions without new samples.
Independence-only withdrawal updates claim scope while retaining justified arithmetic.
Text, replay, metadata and external references remain passive/private as required.
JSON/Markdown preserve all V result states, operands, units, reasons and evidence scope.
Registration, actual exposure and post-hoc/re-analysis distinctions survive comparison reporting.
Exact proxy tokenization, versioned Unicode, normalization, boundaries and MF-11.
Common text subset, missing-text counts, singleton/within-class denominators and limits.
Exact distinct-pair statistic and finite-count identity on the same text subset.
Deployment/control/cap/schema limitations; preserve a qualified C-A path when B is unusable.
Six exact openers, A/B byte equality, C clause, groups, interleaving, pilot and controls.
Exact extracted-text association and empty/absent/truncated/ambiguous cases, without repairs.
All exact per-endpoint coverage/floor/band boundaries, including text-independent P5.
Correct operands/signs/units for P1, both P5 deltas and linked block sets.
MF-18, full 2,000-index replay, mean statistic and fixed percentile interpolation.
One/missing/dependent blocks, equal weighting, explicit attrition and no pseudoreplication.
Fixed-suite sensitivity wording and degenerate ranges with limited evidential meaning.
P1 joint directions, false-favorable contrast, ties and zero-straddling outcomes.
Two P5 comparators, full-pattern routing, proxy-only failure and incomplete prerequisites.
Adverse valid-only P1/quality diagnostics and P5 outside quality match remain visible.
Surface/registry ceiling flags; no secondary-endpoint or ontology substitution.
Complete original/variant M and full A/B/C V fixture-to-report paths, fields and correction.
Actual supplied schema/core/audit/exposure/independence evidence limits the claimed comparison; test routing only.
Adverse results and measurement challenges get symmetric preservation/re-analysis.
